name: Controlling Parents
overview: Scripture teaches that children are to leave their parents and unite with their spouse, establishing a new, God-ordained family unit as seen in Genesis 2:24. While parents have a role in guidance, Proverbs warns against causing strife within the household, highlighting the folly of unrest and the value of wisdom and understanding in building a stable home (Proverbs 11:29; 24:3). Trusting in the Lord provides security even when parental support fails, as Psalms 27:10 assures God's care when earthly parents forsake their children. Additionally, a wise heart listens to correction and controls anger, fostering peace rather than division (Proverbs 12:16; 15:31).
